summary: Created a reusable skill for editing HWPX (Hancom Office Word) files. The trace shows a successful pattern: HWPX is a ZIP archive containing XML content files with placeholders that need replacement. Key lessons: (1) HWPX structure follows OCF (Open Container Format) with content.hpf manifest and section*.xml files, (2) placeholders appear in <hp:t> text elements within <hp:run> nodes, (3) <hp:linesegarray> layout cache elements must be removed from modified paragraphs to prevent rendering issues, (4) always verify no placeholders remain before repackaging. The skill provides both manual workflow guidance and a reusable Python script for common operations.
